prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production sprite atlas for an editable modular 2D courier craft. Image 1 is the golden courier art/style reference. Create ONE ATLAS of EIGHT completely separate isolated individual part sprites in exactly four columns and two rows on actual transparent alpha. All parts face RIGHT in the SAME shallow side view, lit from upper right. They are manufactured components from ONE charming compact gold courier ship; large simple yellow-gold painted shells, deep navy indigo shadow faces, cream upper edge highlights, restrained cyan accents, chunky visible clean pixel clusters, minimal panel lines, no noisy detail, no gradient. Each part has approximately one square gameplay-cell footprint and can attach flush to neighbours on its four cardinal sides. They must be INDIVIDUAL PARTS rather than assembled spacecraft, characters, UI icons or whole vehicles. TOP THIRD Battery: a chunky near-square gold/navy battery housing with one small cyan charge display and pale bottom protective plate. TOP RIGHT Thruster: one short navy exhaust nozzle on the LEFT end of a yellow engine casing with flat mating bulkhead on RIGHT; no flame, no wing, no canopy. BOTTOM LEFT Armor: a chunky yellow forward chin/nose armor panel, flat rear edge on LEFT, smoothly stepped sloping rounded nose on RIGHT, no window; this sits below the cockpit. BOTTOM SECOND Coupler/cockpit: ONE cockpit canopy module, dark navy curved glass under a clean cream rim, golden sloping nose-side frame, flat mating rear edge LEFT and flat underside. This is only the upper nose/cockpit section, not an entire ship, no engine, no tail, no wing. BOTTOM THIRD Spring: one compact horizontal silver compression coil housed between golden end caps, navy recess, flat mating faces. BOTTOM RIGHT Connector: one small plain navy square sleeve with gold rim for joining two modules. Vital design: cargo/beam/battery/thruster/armor/cockpit/spring are seven modular parts, visibly separate, each with identical scale/pixel density. A starter later combines upper row thruster + beam + cargo + cockpit over lower row thruster + beam + battery + armor. Do NOT draw this assembled starter, do not make multiple canopies or whole ships. The atlas alone should be neatly spaced eight separate objects with true transparent background and no cast shadows. Pixel sprites, NOT 3D models or renders, not smooth vector icons.
